title: Microscopes and the Discovery of Cells
summary: How Hooke and Leeuwenhoek discovered cells, how to use a light microscope, and how to estimate cell size.

ib.note: Electron microscopes and resolution follow in MYP 5 / DP

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: The Invisible Living World: Beyond Our Naked Eye
Earlier NCERT Ch 8: Cell: Structure and Functions

objectives: I can describe how cells were discovered and why the microscope was essential.
I can use a light microscope correctly: low power first, focus, then higher power.
I can calculate total magnification and estimate cell size from the field of view.
misconceptions: Cells are big enough to see with the naked eye (a few are, like hen’s eggs).
Higher magnification always shows more of the specimen.
Stains are needed to see every cell.
